title: Design Compressed String Iterator
goal: Read a run-length encoded string one character at a time without expanding it.
strategy: Keep a cursor into the encoded text and a remaining count for the current character. Load a new run only after the previous count reaches zero. Exhausted next calls return one space; hasNext never consumes a character.

edgeCases: A multi-digit count is loaded as one number
Repeated reads after exhaustion return one space each
Repeated availability queries leave the first character untouched
inputRules: The input parser enforces the problem domain and explicit limits for an inspectable trace.
